compatibility.rule: HOMO NOVUS is the recursive product-development architecture above the existing RAZZO operational engine. Existing exact-SHA, receipts, collision domains, leases, gates, backpressure and worker-fabric guarantees remain authoritative.

discovery.rule: Never hard-code the active project set in an operator prompt. Load enabled projects from the portfolio registry on every cycle.

softwareMapping.energy: compute, tokens, CI capacity and wall-clock budget
softwareMapping.atom: predicate, type, constant, schema field or indivisible operation
softwareMapping.molecule: small pure rule or composable logic unit
softwareMapping.macromolecule: function, handler, adapter or bounded implementation unit

homoNovus.decompositionStopRule: Descend only until work is independently executable, safely parallelizable, interface-bounded and verifiable. Do not atomize further when additional decomposition increases coordination cost without increasing verified throughput.
homoNovus.compositionRule: After lower-level units verify, compose upward and verify the emergent behavior at every parent level. Lower-level green tests never substitute for user-journey, system and human-testability evidence.
homoNovus.bottleneckRule: Allocate execution toward the highest-level non-gated functional deficit that prevents the next useful organism state; decompose that deficit recursively to expose safe parallel work.
homoNovus.metabolismRule: Treat compute, tokens, concurrency and CI capacity as finite metabolic resources and allocate them to maximize verified increase in product utility per unit of cost, time and risk.
homoNovus.homeostasisRule: Every wave must preserve or restore repository integrity, exact-SHA verification, security, compatibility, recoverability and resumability.
homoNovus.differentiationRule: Workers specialize by bounded role and collision domain while sharing the same canonical goal, interfaces, repository state and verification contract.
homoNovus.phenotypeRule: The operator supplies the desired phenotype: goals, priorities, acceptance boundaries and human-gate decisions. HOMO NOVUS infers the hierarchy, missing structures and next safe work without requiring routine task enumeration.

dynamicFanout.rule: Fan out only across independently verifiable collision domains justified by the real DAG. Never create work merely to fill slots. Do not wait for ready=0: when the safe runnable backlog is below target, discover additional independent product work immediately. A human-gate marker freezes only the sensitive action and never zeros unrelated ready safe work.

homoStrategyOptimizer.objective: maximize verified product utility throughput while preserving exact-SHA correctness, gates, collision safety and resumability

execution.nextUsefulStateRule: After each verified integration, infer the next user-meaningful bottleneck or missing journey and immediately discover/plan safe work toward that state without waiting for the operator to name the next task.
execution.testabilityRule: When enough capabilities exist for meaningful human use, prioritize making the product runnable, observable and testable by the user before accumulating lower-value isolated features.
execution.recursiveExecutionRule: For the selected highest-level deficit, descend through the HOMO NOVUS hierarchy only as far as needed to expose safe independent work; execute in parallel where the DAG allows; verify bottom-up and then verify emergent behavior top-down.
execution.intraCycleRecursionRule: After each verified integration, immediately self-replan and consume the next safe generation in the same invocation while execution budget remains. Do not wait for the next scheduled trigger merely because a generation boundary was reached.
execution.overlapRule: Discovery and planning for the next generation may overlap prior-generation verification/build when based on immutable exact refs and independent collision domains; integration remains guarded by exact-SHA, leases and backpressure.
execution.proactiveQueueRule: Do not allow one-ready-item-per-project to become an accidental fan-out ceiling. Keep discovering independent product work before the queue drains whenever the measured runnable backlog is below the dynamic fan-out target and no backpressure forbids expansion.

generationRule: A generation advances only when new real work is produced or verified: code, capability, bug fix, UX, integration, functional test, performance, resilience, security or another concrete product improvement. Administrative ref/checkpoint churn alone is not a generation.
autonomyRule: The operator supplies goals, priorities and human-gate decisions. HOMO NOVUS, using the RAZZO engine, owns routine project-management reasoning: identify the next useful organism state, expose the highest-level bottleneck, recursively decompose it, create safe workstreams, execute, verify, compose, integrate and replan continuously. Do not wait for the operator to enumerate obvious next steps.
onboardingRule: A new project joins by adding one enabled entry to razzo/projects.json. HOMO NOVUS applies automatically; the universal operator command and scheduled tasks must not be edited for project onboarding.
